# Synthetic Empatica E4 session

This tiny, invented export is test data for the PhysioNet validator. It follows
the E4 Connect CSV layout: a Unix start time, a sample rate, then signal samples.
IBI.csv instead starts with the start time and `IBI`, followed by rows of
seconds since the start and inter-beat interval in seconds.
The timestamps and signal values do not describe a real person or recording.
